## Description {#details}

Public header folder for the µOS++ Intrusive Lists.

The <code>include</code> folder contains all public header files for the µOS++ Intrusive Lists, serving as the main interface for users and integrators.

Within this folder, you will find the declarations for the core intrusive list classes and templates. All public API definitions are organised here, ensuring a clear separation from implementation details, which are located in the <code>src</code> folder.

The structure of the <code>include</code> folder promotes modularity, maintainability, and straightforward integration. By including the relevant headers from this folder, users can access the full range of features provided by the µOS++ Intrusive Lists in their projects.
